summary: Build practical AML/CFT skills with risk scoring, monitoring, case files, and reporting. Train your team to detect and escalate financial crime risk.
lede: AML/CFT compliance training helps financial crime, KYC, and compliance professionals assess customer and transaction risk and document concerns. It covers customer risk scoring, transaction-alert review, investigation records, sanctions-screening workflows, control testing, and escalation and reporting, with practical exercises to build a risk-rating matrix, case file, and reporting map.
audienceIntro: This course is built for you if you already work in AML, KYC, investigations, compliance, or financial crime risk and need a stronger operational framework. It fits both front-line practitioners and managers who must review cases, challenge controls, and report risk clearly to governance forums.
modules: Customer Due Diligence and Risk Scoring
prerequisites: You should bring familiarity with basic banking, payments, insurance, trade finance, or similar financial services workflows. A laptop is recommended for exercises using templates, risk matrices, and dashboard-style outputs, and you should be prepared to review sample cases and supervisory-style scenarios.
